entries.name: Adaptive movement and fitness
entries.scope: Modify physical activity for disability, chronic illness, pregnancy, aging, injury, environment, and changing capacity.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Maintains safe, meaningful movement using qualified guidance and individualized progression.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.professional_boundary: Health and exercise content must be adapted to the person and does not replace licensed medical care.

entries.name: Pain literacy and safe response
entries.scope: Distinguish soreness, acute injury, chronic pain, referred symptoms, red flags, and fear-driven avoidance.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Uses appropriate load modification and professional evaluation rather than reckless persistence or total withdrawal.

entries.name: Digital and media self-governance
entries.scope: Control notifications, feeds, pornography, gaming, outrage, and compulsive checking through boundaries and friction.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Media use reflects explicit purposes and limits rather than default consumption.

entries.name: Digital competence and data hygiene
entries.scope: Manage devices, backups, accounts, passwords, files, privacy, updates, and common troubleshooting.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Personal data and essential services remain organized, recoverable, and reasonably secure.

entries.name: Digital identity, privacy, and data rights
entries.scope: Understand data collection, tracking, identity linkage, consent, platform policies, and the persistence of online records.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can audit major accounts and change settings, sharing, or services to match stated privacy priorities.

entries.name: Cybersecurity and account resilience
entries.scope: Use strong authentication, updates, backups, encryption, recovery plans, and safe device practices.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can recover access or data and demonstrates reduced exposure to common compromise paths.
